---- MODULE etcd_raft ----
EXTENDS etcd_raftDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgentBackend == INSTANCE TLAPS

LEMMA AgentInitialRoles ==
    Init => \A i \in Server : state[i] # Leader
BY AgentBackend!SMTT("r5"), DistinctRoles
   DEF Init, InitServerVars

\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []LogInv
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF etcd_raft/etcd_raft_LogInv.tla
<1>1. Init => LogInv
    BY AgentBackend!SMTT("r5")
      DEF Init, InitLogVars, InitConfigVars, LogInv, Committed, IsPrefix, SubSeq, Len, LastTerm, GetConfig, GetJointConfig, Quorum
<1>2. LogInv /\ [Next]_vars => LogInv'
    BY AgentBackend!SMTT("r5")
       DEF LogInv, Next, NextAsync, NextCrash, NextUnreliable,
           vars, messageVars, serverVars, candidateVars, leaderVars,
           logVars, configVars
<1>3. QED
    BY <1>1, <1>2, AgentBackend!PTL DEF Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF etcd_raft/etcd_raft_LogInv.tla
